messages:
Sam - People Ops: Heads-up: new hires starting Mon 9am. Need parking, lunch for 8, two accessible desks, and a badge/photo station. Also one hire's SSN is delayed (they have proof of application). Can they still check in and do I-9? @LegalBot @Diego
Ivy - Facilities: Parking: 4 passes available. Conf D reserved 9-11 for orientation. Catering can do sandwich platters + 2 GF. Need names by Friday.
Diego - IT: Laptops can be pre-staged. Imaging window 8:50-9:20. Badge printer available until 10:30. Send emails and device prefs.
Sam - People Ops: I'll DM the asset list. On the SSN: they have the SSA receipt and passport. Is that acceptable?
LegalBot: For I-9, acceptable documents include US passport (List A) or a combination of List B and C. SSA receipt is not a List C document alone; temporary receipts may need additional proof. Remote notarization may be approved case-by-case. Please submit details to compliance@redwood.com for review.
Marta: Hiring manager requests they start remote on day 1 with laptop shipped, until I-9 is completed in-person within 3 days. Is that policy ok?
LegalBot: Starting remote is allowed if manager confirms restricted access no prod creds until I-9 and BG complete. Document the restrictions and notify security.
Sam - People Ops: Noted. We'll ship a non-prod laptop and schedule an in-person I-9 slot by Day 2.
Diego - IT: Shipping ETA Mon morning if sent overnight today. If anyone needs adapters, checkbox in RSVP form.
Reed: Quick Q from new hire: where do I enroll benefits on day 1?
Sam - People Ops: Benefits enrollment link sent in calendar invite. We'll do a 20-min benefits overview at 11:00 and open Q&A after.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: mon-day1-onboard-1777777777 (#20001). Due: 2026-04-12.
Sam - People Ops: Thanks all  I'll follow up once compliance replies and post the final roster.
